table.retrieve:
select   code1 = V.AccCode, 
			date1 = V.date, 
	 		name2 = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
			name1 = (Select name from accounts where acccode = :acccode),		
			name5 = (Select aliasname from accounts where acccode = :acccode),		
	 		value1= V.Debit,
	 		value2= V.Credit,
			name3 = V.Remarks,
			name4 = (Select name from subaccounts where subacccode IN (select subcode from accounts where acccode = :acccode))
from     VirtualGL V	

where    V.AccCode =  :acccode and
			V.date     >= :startdate and
			V.date     <= :enddate	 	
order by   date, name2, debit, credit

objects.name: compute_10
objects.expression: if( sum(OpenBalance for all distinct  code ) + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for all) > 0,'Dr.', 'Cr.' )

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: abs( sum(OpenBalance for all distinct  code ) + Sum(  debit  -  credit  for all))

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: if( OpenBalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for all ) >0,'Dr.', 'Cr.' )

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: abs( OpenBalance + cumulativeSum(  debit  -  credit  for all ))
